Narrator: No. 2. A woman and a man are talking while listening to the TV news. Announcer: The mayoral election will be held in Midori City on the 2nd of next month. There are 4 candidates this time. First, the incumbent, Yuji Tanaka. If re-elected, he wishes to continue focusing on elderly care programs. Next, Eriko Yamada. She plans to promote the physical and mental health of the citizens through improvements in sports environments and the establishment of psychological counseling offices. Following her is Harumi Suzuki. She intends to improve nursery schools, make medical expenses for children free, and tackle the declining birthrate. Lastly, Kazuo Ishii. His idea is to implement a public transportation support project connecting suburban residential areas with the city center, promoting the creation of a highly livable city.
Woman: The mayoral election is coming up soon. I listened to a candidate's speech in front of the station yesterday. Um, the one who said they would promote projects for citizens' health. The talk was specific and the significance was well conveyed. Like maintaining aging sports grounds and setting up counseling windows.
Man: Wow, sometimes you understand things better when you hear them directly.
Woman: I'm thinking of listening to the other candidates' speeches too. I'm concerned about policies related to nursery schools.
Man: I see. My grandmother lives a little far from town, and she often asks me to give her a ride to the supermarket or hospital in the city center. My grandmother often complains that there are no buses. Therefore, I want to support the person who proposes that policy.
Woman: I see. Since the elderly population is also increasing, various forms of support are necessary.
Narrator: Question 1. Whose speech does the woman say she listened to yesterday? Yuji Tanaka / Eriko Yamada / Harumi Suzuki / Kazuo Ishii Question 2. Whose policies does the man say he has high expectations for? Yuji Tanaka / Eriko Yamada / Harumi Suzuki / Kazuo Ishii

旁白: 2号，一个女人和一个男人一边听电视新闻一边聊天。广播员：绿市将于下月2日举行市长选举。这次有4位候选人。首先是现任田中雄二。如果再次当选，他希望继续关注老年护理项目。接下来是山田绘里子。她计划通过改善体育环境、设立心理咨询室等方式，促进公民身心健康。紧随其后的是铃木晴美。她打算改善托儿所、免除儿童医疗费用并解决少子化问题。最后是石井一夫。他的想法是实施连接郊区住宅区与市中心的公共交通配套项目，推动打造高度宜居城市。

여: 시장 선거, 이제 곧이네. 나 어제 역 앞에서 후보자 연설을 들었어. 저기, 시민의 건강을 위한 사업을 추진하겠다는 사람. 이야기가 구체적이고 의의도 잘 전달되더라. 노후화된 운동장 정비라든가 상담 창구 설치 같은 거.
남: 헤에, 직접 들으면 더 잘 이해될 때가 있지.
여: 다른 후보자들 이야기도 들어보고 싶다고 생각하고 있어. 보육원 관련 정책이 마음에 걸려서.
남: 그렇구나. 나는 할머니가 시내에서 조금 떨어진 곳에 살고 계신데, 시내 마트나 병원 갈 때 차로 태워다 달라고 부탁받는 경우가 많거든. 할머니가 버스가 없다고 자주 불만을 말씀하셔. 그래서 그 정책을 내세우는 사람을 지지하고 싶어.
여: 그렇구나. 고령자 인구도 늘어나고 있으니까 여러 가지 지원이 필요하겠지.
내레이터: 질문 1. 여자는 어제 어느 후보자의 연설을 들었다고 말하고 있습니까? 다나카 유지 후보 야마다 에리코 후보 스즈키 하루미 후보 이시이 가즈오 후보 질문 2. 남자는 어느 후보자의 정책에 기대하고 있다고 말하고 있습니까? 다나카 유지 후보 야마다 에리코 후보 스즈키 하루미 후보 이시이 가즈오 후보
script_en:
Narrator: No. 2. A woman and a man are talking while listening to the TV news. Announcer: The mayoral election will be held in Midori City on the 2nd of next month. There are 4 candidates this time. First, the incumbent, Yuji Tanaka. If re-elected, he wishes to continue focusing on elderly care programs. Next, Eriko Yamada. She plans to promote the physical and mental health of the citizens through improvements in sports environments and the establishment of psychological counseling offices. Following her is Harumi Suzuki. She intends to improve nursery schools, make medical expenses for children free, and tackle the declining birthrate. Lastly, Kazuo Ishii. His idea is to implement a public transportation support project connecting suburban residential areas with the city center, promoting the creation of a highly livable city.
Woman: The mayoral election is coming up soon. I listened to a candidate's speech in front of the station yesterday. Um, the one who said they would promote projects for citizens' health. The talk was specific and the significance was well conveyed. Like maintaining aging sports grounds and setting up counseling windows.
Man: Wow, sometimes you understand things better when you hear them directly.
Woman: I'm thinking of listening to the other candidates' speeches too. I'm concerned about policies related to nursery schools.
Man: I see. My grandmother lives a little far from town, and she often asks me to give her a ride to the supermarket or hospital in the city center. My grandmother often complains that there are no buses. Therefore, I want to support the person who proposes that policy.
Woman: I see. Since the elderly population is also increasing, various forms of support are necessary.
Narrator: Question 1. Whose speech does the woman say she listened to yesterday? Yuji Tanaka / Eriko Yamada / Harumi Suzuki / Kazuo Ishii Question 2. Whose policies does the man say he has high expectations for? Yuji Tanaka / Eriko Yamada / Harumi Suzuki / Kazuo Ishii

Le discours était précis et la signification était bien transmise. Comme entretenir des terrains de sport vieillissants et mettre en place des guichets de conseil.

Phát thanh viên: Cuộc bầu cử thị trưởng sẽ được tổ chức tại thành phố Midori vào ngày 2 tháng sau. Lần này có 4 ứng cử viên. Đầu tiên là người đương nhiệm, Yuji Tanaka. Nếu tái đắc cử, ông mong muốn tiếp tục tập trung vào các chương trình chăm sóc người già. Tiếp theo là Eriko Yamada. Cô có kế hoạch nâng cao sức khỏe thể chất và tinh thần của người dân thông qua việc cải thiện môi trường thể thao và thành lập các văn phòng tư vấn tâm lý. Theo sau cô là Harumi Suzuki. Cô dự định cải thiện các trường mẫu giáo, miễn phí chi phí y tế cho trẻ em và giải quyết tỷ lệ sinh đang giảm. Cuối cùng là Kazuo Ishii. Ý tưởng của ông là thực hiện dự án hỗ trợ giao thông công cộng kết nối các khu dân cư ngoại ô với trung tâm thành phố, thúc đẩy việc hình thành một thành phố có mức sống cao.
